fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Under neutral mutation to new alleles and drift, expected heterozygosity reaches an equilibrium that rises with the product of effective population size and mutation rate.

fields.label: Work

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: infinite-alleles mutation, neutrality, constant N_e, equilibrium

fields.label: Formal status in the nanopub
fields.value: proved within the model. Observed diversity varies far less across species than census sizes predict (Lewontin's paradox; Leffler et al. 2012), which points to linked selection and demography.

fields.label: Proposed test
fields.value: Regress genome-wide neutral diversity on independent estimates of N_e times mu across species, and test whether the residual pattern is explained by linked selection.
